items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an affine morphism f : X -> S and a quasi-coherent F on X, WeakAss_S(f_*F) is contained in f(WeakAss_X(F)) (source lines 813-821). The proof passes to the affine case, so that f comes from a ring map A -> B and F from a B-module M, identifies the weakly associated points of F with the weakly associated primes of M and those of f_*F with the weakly associated primes of M as an A-module, and applies the corresponding algebra statement for arbitrary ring maps.
